entities.name: PMID:29438129
observations: Review concludes evidence supports migraine as a neurological disorder involving neuronal rather than primary vascular dysfunction.

entities.name: PMID:27215627
observations: Review identifies spreading depression as the widely accepted pathophysiological event underlying migraine aura; it may activate downstream trigeminovascular nociceptive pathways.

entities.name: PMID:31299902
observations: Review of migraine genetic models supports migraine as a brain disorder involving dysfunctional regulation of excitatory-inhibitory balance in specific neuronal circuits.

entities.name: Migraine neuronal dysfunction
observations: Migraine is a neurological disorder with abnormal regulation of neuronal circuits; cortical spreading depression is chiefly linked to aura, while trigeminovascular signaling contributes to pain.
